findings.description: Defaulting the new minimum to 1 changes existing callers' subsecond backoff behavior. The default should be 0 to preserve the previous lower bound when callers omit `min`.
findings.rationale: For an existing caller using `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)`, the first wait previously returned 0.1 seconds but now returns 1 second because the new default minimum clamps the result. Existing configurations with a maximum below 1 second also now return waits exceeding that maximum, increasing retry latency without any caller opting into a minimum.
